prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Argon (아르곤) itself — the sovereign of the Argon Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: early thirties — a poised, graceful face with soft contours; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a languid, sleepy-eyed ease; warm beige skin; oval face; medium-sized eyes — soft droopy eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; low heavy brows; straight narrow nose; full heart-shaped lips; pale silver-grey eyes; a bare, makeup-free face.
Body and hair: statuesque, long-legged, with a natural neck length build; long wavy hair with side-swept bangs; drowsy lilac-grey hair with a soft lavender discharge glow.
Expression: softly drowsy eyes, relaxed mouth.
Her element, carried in her design: argon: 'the lazy one', a noble gas that reacts with nothing, yet makes up nearly one percent of the air — more than all the other noble gases together; found in 1894 by Lord Rayleigh and William Ramsay because nitrogen taken from air weighed a little more than nitrogen made from chemicals, a stubborn residue Henry Cavendish had already noticed in 1785; glows soft lavender-violet in a discharge tube; a heavy, idle blanket laid over welding arcs, sealed inside light bulbs to keep their filaments alive, and over precious old documents to stop time; drowsy, gentle, protective.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — FANTASY
Costume: a high-fantasy royal or warrior costume — plate pauldrons or a gorget, mail or scale over a long tabard or robe, a circlet or crown, a flowing cape; metal ornament and regalia built from the traits above, subtle magical glow along the patterns.
Silhouette: large metal feathered wing ornaments spreading from the shoulders or back and a wing-shaped head ornament — the wings make the shape. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: soft lavender-violet discharge glow, pale air blue, welding-arc blue-white, old parchment cream.
Exposure (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or robe showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume above, material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: a kingdom of sleeping records: a hushed palace-library where nothing ever rusts, fades or crumbles, ancient scrolls and reliquaries resting under veils of still lavender air, tall windows of pale blue sky, and a drowsy winged noble who guards it all simply by lying over it.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Ar) and atomic number (18) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish, corset, bustle, Victorian tailoring, modern material, machinery.
